parameters.name: equivalent_layer_thickness
parameters.justification: Laminar-equivalent wall layer chosen so that b/(delta+b) reproduces the turbulent result DR = 2*b+/U_b+: delta+ = U_b+/2 = 17.5 viscous units = 95 um. y is normalised by this thickness.

parameters.name: edge_velocity
parameters.justification: Velocity at the top of the equivalent layer such that a no-slip wall carries the baseline shear: U_d = tau0*delta/mu = 50*9.5e-5/1.22e-3 = 3.9 m/s, held fixed (same outer flow).

parameters.name: water_dynamic_viscosity
parameters.justification: Seawater at 15 C, converts du/dy into wall shear stress.
